items.summary: Nikon's microscope business is celebrating its 101st anniversary this year, and Nikon is marking the occasion with a special exhibition at the Tokyo Photographic Art Museum. [Read More]

items.title: Photographer Spends 10 Years Chronicling Women Serving Life Sentences in America
items.summary: A photographer spent over a decade documenting women convicted of homicide and sentenced to life in prison in the U.S. -- challenging the idea that they can be defined by a single act. [Read More]
